fact: The ITU Cyberwellness Profile, last updated 12 March 2015, lists no instruments for specific cybercrime legislation and none for cybersecurity regulation in Eritrea.

The Council of Europe cybercrime office's legal profile, version of 5 May 2020, maps Eritrea's Penal Code (Art. 374 unauthorized use of a computer, covering access, interception, data and system interference, and Art. 298 violation of privacy) to the Budapest Convention's offence articles as its domestic equivalent, and lists Eritrea as not a signatory; it gives no separate cybercrime act.
